decisions.reason: As a generic utility with limited differentiation from standard address tools, its option value is now modest and resources are better shifted to more energy-specific platform offerings.
Austrian gas grid fees are a narrow foreign-market niche with ongoing data-maintenance cost, so after several years the firm would likely abandon it unless clear traction had emerged.
This service fits the firm's regulated-energy core well and still offers strategic option value as part of a broader compliance and calculation platform.
An end-customer tariff database is adjacent to the firm's data and analytics strengths, so it is worth keeping unless later evidence shows weak demand relative to upkeep cost.
Custom web services closely support the firm's consultative and modular SaaS direction, making them a useful option with strong complementarities to the established business.
Postal code lookup is a highly standardized, low-barrier utility with little strategic distinctiveness for this firm's energy-focused platform path.
